speculative_capture.output_ids_scope: Native cumulative accepted outputs only; all IDs and chunk receipt times retained
speculative_capture.token_times_scope: Host receipt timestamp repeated for every token in a chunk; intra-chunk token ITL is unresolved

preemption_summary.semantics: preemption counts come from the native scheduler; recomputed_tokens is the negative computed-token adjustment inside schedule, not a pure preemption recomputation measure when speculation is enabled

queue_semantics: admission_s minus arrival_s is client submission lag; native waiting is scheduler telemetry
native_clock_semantics: arrival_time is epoch; native *_ts are core monotonic; host *_s share perf_counter origin

host_chunk_diagnostics.semantics: tokens in one chunk share receipt time; intra-chunk ITL is unresolved
